instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Create a module that implements a 4-to-1 multiplexer with an enable signal. The module should have four inputs (in0, in1, in2, in3), one 2-bit select signal (sel), an enable signal (en), and one output (out). When the enable signal is high, the module should output the selected input based on the select signal. If the enable signal is low, the output should be 0. Please implement the module using structural Verilog.
